sources.title: This reviewer's bounded CPU execution and raw-result arithmetic
Independent entropy endpoints and aggregation argument
sources.details: For f>=0,sum f=1, h(f)=-f ln f extends continuously by h(0)=0 because lim(f->0+) f ln f=0. h''(f)=-1/f<0 makes H concave and maximal at uniform f=1/N (H=ln N); pure [1,0,...] has H=0. Division by ln4 sends those endpoints to 1 and 0. Four batches, each concentrated on a different expert, can yield global uniform counts, so global entropy does not establish within-batch/type uniformity. Endpoint and counterexample arithmetic are independently executed in cpu-results.json.
